map.→ 打开公关（效果/评估/报告）体系工具: -> Open the public relations (effect / evaluation / report) system tool
map.一场品牌战役收官后，汇总报道篇数、核心媒体数、曝光量，并对情感倾向、信息渗透、危: After a brand campaign wraps up, tally the number of articles, core media outlets and impressions, and score sentiment tendency, information penetration and crisis response 0-5 each to quantify the communication effect.
map.为什么报道篇数不算进效果分？: Why does the number of articles not count towards the effect score?
map.公关效果评估体系从媒体报道、声量、情感倾向、关键信息渗透与危机应对 5 维度量化: The public relations effect evaluation system quantifies communication effect across 5 dimensions - media coverage, volume, sentiment tendency, key message penetration and crisis response - and generates a professional evaluation report.
map.公关（效果/评估/报告）体系 使用指南: Public relations (effect / evaluation / report) system guide
map.关键信息渗透率 = 包含核心传播信息的报道/总报道: Key message penetration rate = articles containing the core message / total articles
map.取决于行业与战役目标。40% 属健康区间（说明近半数报道来自权威信源，背书强）；: It depends on the industry and the campaign goal. 40% is a healthy range, since it means nearly half the coverage comes from authoritative sources and carries strong endorsement. Below 20% the coverage is mostly long-tail self-published media, whose credibility and secondary spread are markedly weaker. This tool only gives you the percentage; the target must be set against your own media matrix.
map.对比战役前设定的 KPI（核心媒体占比目标、曝光目标），看达成度。: Compare against the KPIs set before the campaign (core media share target, impression target) to see how they were achieved.
map.把多场战役的效果分做时间序列，识别「声量高但渗透低」的虚胖战役。: Track the effect scores of several campaigns as a time series to spot inflated campaigns with high volume but low penetration.
map.核心媒体占比 40% 算高吗？: Is a 40% core media share high?
map.篇数是「量」、情感/渗透/危机是「质」，混在一起会被刷量干扰。把篇数、曝光作为展: Article count is quantity while sentiment, penetration and crisis response are quality; mixing them lets article inflation distort the picture. Treat article count and impressions as separate display metrics, and let the effect score judge only whether the right things were said, whether they were said, and whether anything blew up. That is closer to the real goal of public relations - shaping perception rather than piling up pages.
map.：展示指标：报道总篇数、核心媒体报道数、核心媒体占比 = 核心媒体数 ÷ 报道总: : display metrics: total number of articles, number of core media articles, core media share = core media articles / total articles x 100%, and estimated impressions (in ten thousands). Effect score = sentiment tendency + key message penetration + crisis response (each 0-5, maximum 15); grades: 13 and above excellent, 10 and above good, 7 and above pass, below 7 insufficient. Note that article count and impressions are only for display and are not counted in the effect total.
map.：某战役：报道 50 篇、核心媒体 20 篇 → 核心占比 40%；曝光 200: : one campaign has 50 articles with 20 from core media, a core share of 40%, and 20 million impressions; sentiment 5 + penetration 5 + crisis 4 = 14, judged excellent (13 or above). Another campaign also has 50 articles with 20 from core media (still 40%) and 20 million impressions, but sentiment 3 + penetration 3 + crisis 2 = 8, only a pass. Even though it published a lot, its positive sentiment and key message reach are weak - a typical high-volume, low-penetration campaign.
